user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User requests and external interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to individual user queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Fetches web pages at user direction when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content specifically to enhance the relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch images for Google search indexes and related products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and image features across Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch videos for Google search indexes and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Perform crawls for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for internal research and development and various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites for various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs for various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Handle crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawls requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and feeds data for generative AI.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for Apple search features and foundation model usage.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines how data crawled by Applebot is used; does not crawl directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays information such as title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, though may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and supports evaluating and improving agentic AI.
user_agents.scope: Supports agentic AI capabilities, including helping AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search index and Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Public web content used for Bing search and Copilot responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Captures snapshots and previews of web pages.
user_agents.scope: Generates snapshots of web pages in real time.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services, and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content accessed to provide information to customers and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent Amazonbot or use noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to make pages eligible to appear in Amazon search experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using user-agent Amzn-SearchBot or search bot directives.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on a user's behalf to respond to queries.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web stored for bulk download and Map-Reduce processing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / for User-agent: CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
